dataset_name: AEDC Data by Statistical Areas Level 2 (SA2) 2009-2024
publisher: Australian Early Development Census / Dept of Education
geographic_identifier: 9-digit SA2 code; merged areas joined by /
purpose_in_kinderprint: Child development outcome layer; dependent construct for the priority residual model and matched-pair comparison
variables_selected: n_children; vulnerable_n/pct; at_risk_n/pct; on_track_n/pct across 5 domains, 3 summary measures and 3 health subdomains
known_limitations: Child counts ARE published, enabling CIs and significance testing. Suppression: # = 3 or fewer children assessed; * = <15 valid scores or <2 teachers or <80% coverage. 13 Greater Melbourne rows are merged SA2 groups. Assignment is residence-based (confirmed). Median community has 122 children, so 95% CI is about +/-7 points.

dataset_name: ASGS Edition 3 - SA2 digital boundaries and Main Structure
purpose_in_kinderprint: Geographic backbone; join target for all tabular sources; geometry for dissolve, zonal statistics and choropleths
variables_selected: SA2_CODE_2021, SA2_NAME_2021, SA3/SA4/GCCSA/STATE codes and names, geometry
known_limitations: CRITICAL: ABS released Edition 4 in July 2026 and it is now the default download. Edition 4 SA2 codes partially match Edition 3 and would fail silently. Edition 3 pinned explicitly. Stored EPSG:7844; all areas computed in EPSG:3577. Special-purpose SA2s carry no geometry and are excluded with a log.

dataset_name: Socio-Economic Indexes for Areas (SEIFA) 2021 - SA2 indexes
purpose_in_kinderprint: Reference against which off-trend AEDC performance is defined (priority V1); OUT-OF-SAMPLE validation of match quality since ADR-006 removed it from the matching metric
variables_selected: irsd_score, irsd_decile_aus, irsd_pct_aus, irsd_min_sa1, irsd_max_sa1 (derived: irsd_sa1_spread)
known_limitations: SEIFA 2026 not available until early 2028, so 2021 is 3 years older than AEDC 2024. IRSD is built FROM Census income/education/employment - never combined with those variables in one metric (ADR-006). ABS excludes 5 Greater Melbourne SA2s for low population; 3 are ones AEDC independently merged. Area-level measure; ecological fallacy applies.

dataset_name: 2021 Census General Community Profile DataPack, SA2, Victoria
purpose_in_kinderprint: Matching covariates (all 7 under ADR-006) and demographic context in the community profile
variables_selected: G01 population and age 0-4; G02 median age/household income/rent/household size/persons per bedroom; G32 one-parent families; G46B unemployment; G49B qualifications
known_limitations: 2026 Census first release June 2027, so 2021 is the only option. ABS randomly perturbs small cells. Growth-corridor SA2s changed materially between 2021 and the AEDC 2024 collection. Only 6 of 129 tables ingested, by design.

dataset_name: Metropolitan Melbourne Urban Heat Islands and Urban Vegetation 2018
publisher: Department of Transport and Planning (DELWP) with RMIT and CSIRO, Plan Melbourne Action 91
purpose_in_kinderprint: Environment domain: tree canopy and urban heat island. Environmental difference signature between matched communities. Never used as matching features.
variables_selected: PERANYTREE (adopted as vegetation indicator), UHI18_M, PERANYVEG, PERGRASS, PERSHRUB, PERTR03_10, PERTR10_15, PERTR15PL
known_limitations: 55,603 mesh blocks, EPSG:7844. UHI is mean difference in Landsat land surface temperature from a non-urban baseline; vegetation accuracy stated better than 90%. On 2016 mesh blocks vs our 2021 SA2s - harmonised by spatial overlay, not code crosswalk (ADR-005). Coverage stops at the urban boundary: 12 peri-urban communities flagged, values suppressed below 50% areal coverage. 2018 data vs AEDC 2024, defensible because the 2024 cohort was born around 2018-19.

dataset_name: Open Space (metropolitan Melbourne open space network)
publisher: Victorian Planning Authority, built from VEAC 2011 and 32 metropolitan councils
purpose_in_kinderprint: Environment domain: public open space share. Proxy for access to play environments.
variables_selected: open_space_pct (derived from filtered polygon area / community area)
known_limitations: 38,810 polygons in EPSG:3857 (Web Mercator) - the file's own HA column is NOT used because Web Mercator inflates areas near Melbourne by roughly 60%; areas recomputed in EPSG:3577. Includes restricted public land and some private open space, so filtered to OS_TYPE=Public open space AND OS_ACCESS=Open AND OS_STATUS=Existing, excluding tertiary institutions, schools, golf courses, cemeteries (ADR-005). One park appears as several parcels, so polygons are dissolved before area is summed. Filename says Draft.

dataset_name: Family Maternal Child Health Centre Locations
purpose_in_kinderprint: Prototype child-health service location ingestion and spatial QA
variables_selected: name; address; phone; opening hours; appointment field; coordinates
known_limitations: Coverage is City of Casey only. Presence does not establish capacity, waiting time, eligibility, affordability or quality. Must not rank all Greater Melbourne localities.

dataset_name: Child and Youth Social Health Atlas of Australia: PHA workbook
ASGS_edition: PHA correspondence based on ASGS 2021 SA2
purpose_in_kinderprint: Regional child-health context and data-gap assessment
variables_selected: Immunisation; long-term conditions; asthma; mental health; NDIS autism; age-specific emergency presentations for respiratory, mental, digestive, musculoskeletal, genitourinary and injury conditions
known_limitations: PHA is coarser than KinderPrint reporting localities. Values are not copied to component SA2s and are excluded from SA2 suitability scoring. Service-use measures reflect access and coding as well as health need.

dataset_name: EPA Air Watch All Sites Air Quality Hourly Averages - Yearly
variables_selected: PM2.5; PM10; nitrogen dioxide; ozone; station coordinates; units; instrument method; validation flag; observation completeness
known_limitations: Annual station and method summaries only. Monitor readings are not copied to SA2s or treated as locality-wide exposure. Missing readings may reflect maintenance or outages. Validated negative instrument readings remain in the audit output.

publisher: Geoscience Australia using National Health Services Directory
reference_period: Active facilities at source extract date
licence: CC BY 4.0; incorporates G-NAF under its End User Licence Agreement
geographic_identifier: NHSD service identifier; G-NAF address detail PID where available
purpose_in_kinderprint: Greater Melbourne facility presence and counts
variables_selected: Active general practices; hospitals; pharmacies; organisation name; address; coordinates; NHSD service type; G-NAF PID
known_limitations: Facility presence is not capacity, accessibility, waiting time, affordability, eligibility, specialist staffing or quality. Same-SA2 counts do not capture cross-boundary access. The source does not support paediatric or other specialty classification.
